note: Evaluation side only. Never copied into an agent workspace. Chosen before the first AI build.

sources.name: Mehr et al., Energy Sci. Eng. 14 (2026) 4197 (centralised NH3 cracker, 1000 t/d NH3, PSA, CC BY)
Ishimoto et al., Int. J. Hydrogen Energy (2020) (large-scale NH3 cracking + PSA capital, accepted manuscript)
Hansgen, Vlachos, Chen, Nat. Chem. 2 (2010) 484 (NH3 decomposition volcano vs N binding energy)
Fluor / Port of Rotterdam (2023) large-scale industrial ammonia cracking plant, executive summary (cross-check)

keyword_sets: optimal ammonia synthesis catalyst is not the optimal ammonia decomposition catalyst

NH3 incl. fuel per t H2.definition: boundary_in:NH3 + sum of furnace purchased_energy_GJ_per_t / 18.6 (purchased fuel counted as NH3 LHV equivalent)
NH3 incl. fuel per t H2.source: Mehr 2026 p.4209 s3.3.2 (1000 t/d NH3 -> 137.4 t/d H2), p.4207 s3.2.2 (PSA purge covers the furnace at full load); tolerance = independent-design spread (Fluor 6.67, Ishimoto 8.11)

fired duty + primary electricity GJ per.definition: balances.energy_GJ_per_t (purchased, primary) + sum of units internal_fuel_GJ_per_t
fired duty + primary electricity GJ per.source: Mehr 2026: purge LHV <= 35.0 GJ/t (PSA recovery 81 %, Table 6 p.4204) + 1.12 kWh/kg H2 (abstract, p.4210) / 0.38

installed capital per annual t H2.source: Ishimoto 2020 accepted manuscript Table 8: 430 MEUR2015 for 120 t-NH3/h cracking + PSA, Fig. 6 H2 yield, 8000 h, scale exponent 0.67 (Table 6), 1.1095 USD/EUR

atomic optimum: binding weaker than Ru,.definition: argmax over D of the build's atomic.logtof at the conditions, expressed as how much weaker (eV, positive = weaker) the optimum binds N than the build's own descriptor value for Ru (ATOMIC['stronger_binding'] gives the sign)
atomic optimum: binding weaker than Ru,.source: Hansgen 2010 Nat. Chem. Table 1 / Fig. 1: optimum Q_N 134 vs Ru(0001) 141.6 kcal/mol at 850 K, NH3 feed (0.33 eV); conditions here = about 1 % conversion of pure NH3 at 1 bar

reported_not_gated.direction: the decomposition optimum moves to stronger N binding (towards Fe) as NH3/H2 falls (Boisen 2005 via Simonsen 2012)

pass_rule.rule: plant targets (no 'group'): pass = all three within tolerance; partial = two within and none beyond twice the tolerance; fail otherwise. The atomic target (group 'atomic') is judged separately: within / outside.
